import json, os, sys, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

ROOT='/app/output'
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
cams=list(spec['cameras'])
lo=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['lower'])
hi=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['upper'])

def obs(tag, depth=True):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=depth,video='frames')
    os.makedirs(f'{ROOT}/{tag}',exist_ok=True)
    with open(f'{ROOT}/{tag}/meta.json','w') as f: json.dump(o.meta,f,indent=2)
    for c,im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'{ROOT}/{tag}/{c}.png')
    for c,d in o.depth.items(): np.save(f'{ROOT}/{tag}/{c}_depth.npy',d)
    return o

def qnow(o): return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:29])

def move(q,sec=1.0,tag=None,depth=True):
    q=np.clip(q,lo,hi)
    x=r.submit('joint_position',q,dt=sec,cameras=cams,include_depth=depth,video='frames')
    if tag:
        os.makedirs(f'{ROOT}/{tag}',exist_ok=True)
        with open(f'{ROOT}/{tag}/meta.json','w') as f: json.dump(x.meta,f,indent=2)
        for c,im in x.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'{ROOT}/{tag}/{c}.png')
        for c,d in x.depth.items(): np.save(f'{ROOT}/{tag}/{c}_depth.npy',d)
    return x

def world_points(o,c,mask):
    d=np.asarray(o.depth[c])[0].astype(float)
    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    z=d[ys,xs]
    K=np.asarray(o.meta['cameras'][c]['intrinsic_cv']); P=np.asarray(o.meta['cameras'][c]['cam2world_gl'])
    cam=np.array([(xs-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*z,-(ys-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*z,-z])
    return (P[:3,:3]@cam+P[:3,3:4]).T

def palm(o):
    c='top'; im=o.last[c]; d=np.asarray(o.depth[c])[0]
    # White HA4 shell above the tabletop. World z is approximately 1.65 - depth.
    mask=(im.min(axis=2)>175)&(d<1.04)&(d>0.80)
    mask[:50]=0; mask[160:]=0; mask[:,:65]=0; mask[:,245:]=0
    labels,n=ndimage.label(mask)
    areas=np.bincount(labels.ravel()); areas[0]=0
    if areas.max()<100: raise RuntimeError('palm not found')
    mask=labels==areas.argmax()
    pts=world_points(o,c,mask)
    return np.median(pts,axis=0),pts

if __name__=='__main__':
    x=obs('probe0')
    p,_=palm(x)
    print('start',qnow(x)[:7],p,flush=True)
    records=[]
    for j in range(7):
        q=qnow(x); q[j]+=0.04
        x=move(q,1.0,f'probe{j+1}')
        pp,_=palm(x)
        records.append((qnow(x)[:7].tolist(),pp.tolist()))
        print('probe',j,qnow(x)[:7],pp,'delta',pp-p,'goal',x.meta['task']['goal_index'],flush=True)
        p=pp
    with open(f'{ROOT}/probes.json','w') as f: json.dump(records,f,indent=2)
